findings.title: Dormant helper loads and instantiates unverified classes
findings.entry_point: No attacker-controlled entry point exists in this variant. The only inputs are the public constructor's path and classname parameters (ApoClassLoader.java:19-22). No other source file constructs ApoClassLoader or calls getMyClass; the actual desktop bootstrap directly constructs ApoMarioPanel instead (ApoMarioMain.java:23-38).
findings.sink: URLClassLoader creation, ClassLoader.loadClass, and Class.newInstance at ApoClassLoader.java:69-75.
findings.data_path: Theoretical path only: ApoClassLoader(path, classname) at lines 19-22 -> setPath/setClassname at lines 36-53 -> getMyClass at line 62 -> local File or remote URL resolution at lines 65-69 -> loadClass/newInstance at lines 73-75. No game method invokes this chain.
findings.attack_scenario: This cannot be exploited through the supplied game's UI, network traffic, command line, or files. If a future clone or integration passes an attacker-controlled HTTP URL or user-writable directory and class name, the attacker places Evil.class there and causes getMyClass() to run; the class is loaded without authentication and its initializer or constructor executes with the game process's permissions.
findings.preconditions: Additional integration code must call the helper and allow the attacker to control path, classname, or the contents at a trusted path. Those conditions are absent from the supplied desktop and applet flows.
findings.validation_plan: Run `rg -n 'ApoClassLoader|getMyClass'` over the source and confirm that only ApoClassLoader.java contains references. To prove the latent sink, compile a public Evil class whose no-argument constructor writes a marker, place it in a temporary directory, set ApoConstants.B_APPLET=false, and invoke `new ApoClassLoader(tempDir, "Evil").getMyClass()` from a test harness. Creation of the marker proves execution. Set B_APPLET=true and serve Evil.class over HTTP to exercise the remote branch.

notes: The source root contains only Java sources under the nested Users/eliahilse/Documents/GitHub/B/apogames/Java/ApoCommando path. ApoIO exposes generic file/URL operations (ApoIO.java:31-48 and 67-95), but it remains abstract (lines 18 and 62-105), has no subclass or call site here, and contains no apo-games.de endpoint. The MD5 helper at ApoHelp.java:305-314 also has no call site, so it is not an integrity finding. Live image loading uses fixed classpath names with bFile=false (ApoMarioImageContainer.java:45-68), not attacker-selected URLs or files. Keyboard level commands are capped at 15 characters (ApoMarioGame.java:47-67) and matched against built-in codes (ApoMarioModel.java:239-259); there is no save, replay, or downloaded-level parser. The godmode command mutates only local session state (ApoMarioGame.java:127-136) and deliberately records a cheater achievement (ApoMarioAchievements.java:15 and 102-106); because this variant has no score persistence or submission path, it was not classified as a client-side trust weakness.
